code.description: The kind of finding (a code of `x-rdock-codes`).

hint.description: What to do, when something can be done.

level.description: How faithfully the item was carried over.

security.description: The item is a security-relevant choice (for example Traefik's `exposedByDefault`).

source.description: The source item it accounts for; absent for a finding about the written result.

target.description: The generated object, as a path in rdock.yaml (`routes.web`), when there is one.

ItemKind.description: What kind of thing a source item is.

oneOf.description: A key of a configuration file, as a dotted path (`http.routers.web.rule`).
A whole file, or a Compose service as a whole.
A configuration directive (NGINX), named as written.

Level.description: How faithfully a source item was carried over.

oneOf.description: The same behaviour; the object is written.
Needs a decision: left out (or written disabled), and the report says what to do.
No equivalent: left out, and the report says why.

file.description: The file it was read from (`-` for standard input).

item.description: The item: a label key, a dotted file key, a flag, a variable name, an object name.

kind.description: What kind of item it is.

scope.description: The object it belongs to in the file: a Compose service, a static section.

checked_against.description: The version the translation was checked against, e.g. `Traefik v3.7`.

approximate.description: Items carried over with a stated difference.

exact.description: Items carried over with the same behaviour.

items.description: Source items read; each is accounted for by exactly one finding.

result.description: Findings about the written result (no source item), counted apart.

findings.description:
Every finding: one per source item (in reading order), then the findings about the
result.

rdock_version.description: The rdock version that wrote it.

x-rdock-codes.help: Name the backend's CA (`tls.ca_file`) or, for a backend with a self-signed certificate you accept, set `tls.verify: false` on its service.
